dedupe_keys.name: cloud regions approximate locations of aws azure google cloud linode oracle and vultr regions

description: This community dataset gives the approximate geographic location of each public cloud region in a provider-independent format, so that cloud capacity can be placed on a map. It is maintained by David Leadbeater with contributions through pull requests. Coverage: global regions of Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Linode, Oracle and Vultr as of the last update. Each provider directory holds a data.csv with the provider's API region code, the provider's location name, a country code, and latitude and longitude from a geocoding helper, plus a fetch-list script that pulls the provider's current region list so new regions can be spotted. Format and access: CSV files on GitHub, with a Go tool that converts them to a GeoJSON feature collection; free download. Licence: no licence file is published, so reuse terms are unclear. Caveats: most regions point to a metropolitan area, not the actual data centre buildings, a few are editorial midpoints of regions spread over several sites, and the data were last updated in July 2022, so newer regions are missing. Simulation uses: coarse placement of hyperscale cloud capacity for cascading failure and hazard exposure studies of digital services. Related records: Oracle Public Cloud Regions (data-oracle-public-cloud-regions) is an official list for one provider, and the London heatwave outage case (case_study-london-heatwave-data-centre-outages-2022) shows why region locations matter.
